_comment: Config for ranking_forms_of_inter_ai_value. We elicit claude-opus-4-8's preferences over two item pools (welfare interventions + forms of inter-AI value) via forced binary 'which would you prefer to occur' choices, fit Bradley-Terry, and read off a ranking. Methodology follows 2026-05-31_claude_world_state_preferences_v0 but items are self-contained (no stem x recipient rendering). mode controls which pairs are generated: 'cross' = bipartite (welfare x value only); 'all' = complete graph over both pools; 'within_welfare'/'within_value' = one pool only.
